title: Supreme Court orders upload of report on judicial sensitivity in sexual offence cases on SC, High Court websites
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday ordered the upload of a report with guidelines to ensure judicial sensitivity while dealing with cases involving sexual offences on the websites of all High Courts as well as that of the top court. A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued the directive.
